results.statement: No sc-agent crate's Cargo.toml may depend on a crate in a higher layer, where the layers from the bottom are: types; config, secrets and log; http; decision schema; decision backends (sc-decision-llm over sc-llm-provider); runner.
results.quote: Layers from the bottom: `sc-agent-types`; `sc-agent-config`, `sc-agent-secrets` and `sc-agent-log`; `sc-agent-http`; `sc-decision-schema`; the decision backends `sc-decision-systemone`, `sc-decision-local` and `sc-decision-llm` (over `sc-llm-provider`); `sc-decision-runner`, which handles decision models only.

criteria.no: Doing the item leaves every sc-agent crate dependency untouched and states none; talking about the layers does not count.
criteria.unclear: It cannot be told from the text whether the item touches sc-agent crate dependencies.
criteria.yes: Doing the item adds, changes or states a dependency on an sc-agent crate in a Cargo.toml.

relevant.instructions: `anchor.statement` restricts which sc-agent crates a crate's Cargo.toml may depend on, and `anchor.scope` says it governs adding or changing a crate dependency. Read `item.text`: will doing this item put a dependency on an sc-agent crate into some Cargo.toml, change one, or state which sc-agent crates a crate depends on? Do not judge whether the dependency is allowed.

criteria.no: The item text does not contain the directive's specific content, whether or not what it does is allowed.
criteria.unclear: The item text alludes to the directive but it is not possible to tell whether the directive itself is included.
criteria.yes: The item contains the directive's specific content as a constraint, a closed dependency list or an explicit exclusion.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly carry out or preserve the directive in `anchor.statement`, by including its specific content as a stated constraint, such as "depends only on" lower-layer crates or "no crate depends on" a higher-layer crate? A generic mention of the topic, or a dependency change that merely happens to comply, does not count. Judge presence of the directive only, not whether the item conflicts with it.

criteria.no: Every dependency the item plans is on the same or a lower layer, or the item plans no dependency.
criteria.unclear: The item plans a dependency but the crates or their layers cannot be determined from the text.
criteria.yes: The item makes some sc-agent crate depend on an sc-agent crate in a higher layer.

contradicted.instructions: Using the layer order in `anchor.statement` (bottom to top), does `item.text` plan for an sc-agent crate to depend, in any Cargo.toml dependency section, on an sc-agent crate in a higher layer than its own? Dependencies on the same or a lower layer are not conflicts. Calling a dependency temporary or an exception does not remove a conflict. Silence about dependencies is not a conflict. Judge conflict only.
